ai.title: Add readfiles tool to backend
ai.summary: Introduced `read_files` tool in `backend/src/system-prompt.ts` to read specific file paths directly, preferring it over `find_files` when paths are known. Updated `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` to parse `read_files` calls, extract paths, and fetch file versions via `getFileVersionUpdates`. Refactored `backend/src/request-files-prompt.ts` for formatting and added `assistantPrompt` to debug logs.

eli5.text: The assistant built into the backend can now open and read specific known files directly by name instead of always describing what it wants and hoping to find it. If you watched a debugging session or log, you'd see a new 'read files' request appear and the assistant quietly pull in the contents of whatever path it already knew, rather than running a broad search. It works today, and the only people who benefit are those working on or testing the backend tooling itself.

ai.title: findfiles uses description instead of full response
ai.summary: find_files tool now passes description to getFileVersionUpdates instead of fullResponse. The prompt builder extracts content into contentAttributes.description for find_files. Messages array includes the assistant response for context. Affects backend/src/main-prompt.ts.

eli5.text: When you ask the assistant to find files, it now searches using a short description of what you want instead of sending the entire response each time. This makes the file-finding feature run more efficiently by trimming how much text it processes. You won't see any change in what the feature does, but it should work a bit smoother behind the scenes. The update is already live today.
